values.note: Book on the operator's BookMySites page up to a year ahead; full payment at booking. Online bookings of deluxe sites run to 14 nights; longer stays (weekly/monthly, up to 6 months) by phone, 828-894-2331. Holiday and event bookings non-refundable. Check-in at the office.

note: Wooded campground on Silver Creek Rd near Mill Spring (Polk Co), in the foothills by Lake Adger; under new owners, rustic rather than a resort. Also cabins and glamping tents. Google 4.1 over 221 reviews. --Claude
summary: Confirmed RV sites from $50 on the operator's site and booking engine, reservable online with full payment. Changed nightly_high 65 -> 70 (deluxe sites $70 on the engine). Added 50-amp, water, sewer (deluxe), showers and laundry, BookMySites booking a year out. Gate: $50 base (6 water/electric sites), not over US$50. Long-stay tests pass: ~88 RV sites sell nightly online; weekly/monthly up to 6 months by phone. Note trimmed of rate text.
flags: Price gate (info): base $50/night for the six water/electric sites, exactly at the US$50 line (taxes not shown); the deluxe full-hookup sites are $70. Nearest gateway Asheville 44 km; the family has not stayed here.

Long-stay (info): the RV page pitches 'seasonal stays or weekend getaways' and policies allow stays up to 6 months with monthly billing, but the booking engine sells all RV site types nightly (1-night minimum), so test 4 passes.
